# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games where numbers must be placed or satisfied according to mathematical or positional rules*
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan
- Five Cells
- Yosenabe

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes*
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Five Cells
- Choco Banana
- Nuritwin

> *(Note: Five Cells fits both categories; placed here as primary)*

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing Games
*Games where players draw continuous paths, loops, or connected routes*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hebi
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Dotchi-Loop
- Pencils

## 4. Island & Connectivity Games
*Games centered on connecting or isolating groups of cells or nodes*
- Nurikabe
- Hashiwokakero
- Akari
- Kurodoko
- Nurimisaki
- Satogaeri

## 5. Shading & Painting Games
*Games where cells must be shaded or colored according to specific rules*
- Hitori
- Heyawake
- Norinori
- LITS
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Kurotto
- Usowan
- Yajilin
- Chained Block

## 6. Shape & Tetromino Placement Games
*Games involving placement of specific geometric shapes or polyominoes*
- Shakashaka
- Sto-stone
- Sashigane
- Heyawake

> *(Note: Heyawake fits both shading and shape categories; placed in shading as primary)*

## 7. Object & Element Movement Games
*Games involving sliding, moving, or directing objects within the grid*
- Yosenabe
- Nagareru

---

> **Note:** Several games share characteristics across categories. Each game has been assigned to its single most representative category based on its primary mechanic.
